canvas.background: #F8F8F6 off-white with faint light-grey grid lines

illustration.description: Black-and-white hand-drawn ink line art of a slim young man with short wavy dark hair standing front-facing with arms fully outstretched horizontally at shoulder height, shirtless, wearing a light-grey plain boxer-style short pair, barefoot, standing on a thin hatched floor line. A long flexible measuring tape with black tick marks lies across both outstretched arms and hands, with fingertips at the ends. Behind the figure is a vertical hatched wall panel with diagonal cross-hatching in light grey, and two thin vertical boundary lines frame the figure. Clean sketch linework, monochrome black on white, subtle crosshatch shading, no color, no text, no labels, no arrows.
